title: Attach task-scoped handoffs to task claims
description: Integrate retained task context into both claim paths. Flat-file GetNextTask and UpdateTaskStatus when targeting inProgress must load and validate handoffs before changing task state, then attach every retained record whose taskId matches the claimed task, newest-first, through TaskView.handoffs. Corrupt handoff storage must fail before the claim mutation. Regular list/show/create/update/pause/done responses must remain unchanged. Extend human task printing with a handoffs section only when attached and preserve additive backward-compatible JSON output.

comments.message: Started implementation: reviewing flat-file claim paths, handoff storage, and existing output contracts.
